audit_items.proof_trace: The close_factor_bypass_min_value mechanism at L1006 (`if debt_value <= liquidation_params.close_factor_bypass_min_value { return }`) correctly restricts its bypass to positions where debt_value is at or below the configured threshold; `debt_value` is oracle-derived with ceiling rounding making the bypass marginally harder to achieve. The separate bad-debt bypass at L984-992 (`if collateral_total_value <= 1.01 * debts_total_value`) is an independently designed, clearly-commented mechanism that protects the protocol from bad debt accumulation and does not misuse the close_factor_bypass_min_value parameter. All three liquidation paths (handle_liquidation, handle_debt_auto_deleverage, handle_collateral_auto_deleverage) consistently propagate close_factor_bypass_min_value from MarketConfiguration through LiquidationParams to ensure_liquidate_borrow_allowed.
